description: Adds or removes Vertica database user and, optionally, assigns roles.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Name of the Vertica cluster. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: expired
parameters.description: Sets the user’s password expiration. Choices: false true

parameters.name: ldap
parameters.description: Set to true if users are authenticated using LDAP. The user is created with password expired and set to $ldap$. Choices: false true

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate with.

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate with. Default: "dbadmin"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The user’s password encrypted by the MD5 algorithm. The password must be generated with the format "md5" + md5[password + username], resulting in a total of 35 characters. An easy way to do this is by querying the Vertica database with select 'md5'|| md5('<user_password><user_name>').

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Vertica cluster port to connect to. Default: "5433"

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Comma separated list of roles to assign to the user.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to create (present), drop (absent), or lock (locked) a user. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "locked"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Name of the user to add or remove.

examples:
- name: Creating a new vertica user with password
  community.general.vertica_user: name=user_name password=md5<encrypted_password> db=db_name state=present

- name: Creating a new vertica user authenticated via ldap with roles assigned
  community.general.vertica_user: name=user_name ldap=true db=db_name roles=schema_name_ro state=present
